description: Pins the save-byte capture schema used by oracle save/load parity verification. Each capture pairs a slot id with the raw save file bytes, a SHA-256 hash of the bytes, the byte length, and a tic-bound capture timestamp. The schema mirrors vanilla DOOM 1.9 SAVE_HEADER_SIZE plus payload structure so a saved file written by the reference DOOM.EXE can be compared byte-for-byte with a saved file written by the TS engine for the same scripted run.
